spans.s:
औ The diphthong Au or Ou, having the same sound as in Our, and
considered as the fourteenth vowel of the Nagari alphabet.

औ ind. An interjection of, 1. Calling, (ho! hola.)
 2. Of addressing,
(the vocative particle oh.)
 3. A particle of prohibition, and 4. Of
asseveration.

औ m. (औः) The serpent ANANTA.
 f. (औः) The earth.
औ ind. The mystical prefix proper for Śūdras: see ओम्.
